_comment: Merge the mcpServers block into ~/.claude.json (the top-level single-file state, NOT ~/.claude/settings.json). Replace 'mac-test' with the Tailscale MagicDNS hostname of your Mac test machine.
_v0_3_note: macbox-gui v0.3.0 uses FastMCP on port 8767 with logical-pixel screenshot, native multi-client streamable-http, and advisory acquire/release state model. Pair with the using-macbox skill from platforms/macos/skills/.
_v0_4_transport: Migrated SSE -> streamable-http: long tool calls broke SSE keep-alive and yielded -32602 forever. type is now 'http' (Claude Code accepts 'http' or 'streamable-http' as aliases). Endpoint path is /mcp instead of /sse.
_recommended_install: Use scripts/install-agent-side.py --platform macbox-gui --hostname <DEVICE_HOSTNAME> instead of editing this file by hand.
